data.body: Post-close clone-local integrity note: the exact 21 event bytes, tree delta, reducers, links, and fresh authoritative clone all passed; the fresh clone passed git fsck --strict. The adopted AWS live worktree default fsck also exposed stale invalid reflog entries pointing at pruned pre-rewrite objects. This is clone-local reflog residue rather than reachable branch corruption: GitHub compare reports tickets ahead of publication commit 3239a5d7 by 1,087 commits with behind_by=0, and the live bot remains healthy. No reflog expiry, reset, deletion, or garbage collection was performed; the forensic clones remain preserved. Longer-horizon clone/history hygiene remains in the existing future history-policy scope.
